decisions.reason: Removing the redundant integrated-board measurement-coverage attribute does not change DCDC1 voltage regulation, load coverage, or stability requirements.
The current-monitoring attribute removal does not alter the AXP2101 power source, charging behavior, required rails, or battery-efficiency goal.
The source decision does not change the 5V boost converter, its enable control, routing, or powered loads.
The charge-status display and external LED interface remain valid and are unrelated to removal of a 3.3V current-measurement coverage attribute.
The discussion permits flexible connector placement on the integrated board but does not change the panel power-button connector, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
Battery NTC monitoring and its AXP2101 thermal-protection function are unaffected by the current-monitoring coverage cleanup.
The source decision does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or associated protection-component requirements.
AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer and assembly requirements remain unchanged.
The source does not resolve or modify the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, pin functions, part number, or ambiguous pin order.
The SPS30 connector, power, I2C signals, SEL connection, and logic-level compatibility remain valid on the integrated board.
Flexible board placement and the monitoring-coverage cleanup do not change the external backlight circuit, supply options, brightness control, or current requirement.

The standalone USB 3.3V supply still powers the complete downstream rail; deleting a redundant current-monitoring coverage attribute does not alter its regulator, activation condition, or source-selection behavior.
